comment: Sub-project 2b spec, 'Frame cost: the deferred budget' and 'Performance budgets (summary)' (render_bench; medians of GPU ms, Release, reference machine: RTX 5070 Laptop GPU). Each budget is gated from the 2b build step that delivers it: render_bench --check gates those with gatedFrom <= currentStep and reports the rest as pending. A pass budget measures the sum of its passes' medians ('x.*' is every pass named x.<something>); 'frame' is the frame's rendering on the GPU without the final copy out. Per-pass budgets of a scene may be moved between its passes by the step that measures them (spec rule); a frame budget, a capture budget or a total never rises without Frank's ruling.

budgets.name: rt.gi
budgets.moved: 2b step 13 (spec rule, 'Frame cost'): 0.30 -> 0.10 toward lighting; measures 0.065. Frank's ruling 2026-10-29: 0.10 -> 0.11 for the bounce's shadow ray (one sampled light per GI hit), measured 0.101

budgets.name: lighting
budgets.moved: 2b step 13 (spec rule, 'Frame cost'): 0.12 -> 0.32 from rt.gi; Cornell's 12 lights all render now (the 8-light cap is gone), about 0.022 ms a light over a 0.027 ms base, and the BRDF is held exact by test 8
